exams.name: Real Estate Broker Examination
exams.notes: Commission may contract with an independent testing agency to prepare, grade, or conduct the examination.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Alabama Real Estate Commission), may be administered by independent testing agency
exams.quote: every applicant for a broker's or salesperson's license shall submit to a reasonable written examination. The commission shall conduct examinations at places and times it prescribes. The commission may contract with an independent testing agency to prepare, grade, or conduct the examination.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Beginning with the license period effective October 1, 2004, the renewal fee for a broker's license shall be ninety-five dollars ($95) per year for each year of the license period.

required.quote: Each applicant for renewal of an active salesperson or broker license issued by the commission shall, on or before September 30 of the final year of each license period, submit proof of completion of not less than 15 clock hours of approved continuing education course work to the commission, in addition to any other requirements for renewal.

hours_per_period.quote: submit proof of completion of not less than 15 clock hours of approved continuing education course work to the commission

period_years.quote: The 15 clock hours' course work requirement shall apply to each two-year license renewal, and hours in excess of 15 shall not be cumulated or credited for the purpose of subsequent license renewals.

available.quote: A person who holds a current broker license in another state, including persons who move to and become residents of Alabama, shall apply for a reciprocal broker license on a form prescribed by the commission.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current broker license in another state, submit proof of licensure, complete at least six hours of Alabama real estate course work approved by the commission, and pass a written examination on Alabama real estate. Applicants for a reciprocal license are not subject to the complete examination or temporary license requirements of Section 34-27-33.
requirements.quote: The applicant shall submit proof that he or she has a current real estate license in another state as evidenced by a certificate of licensure, together with any other information required by the commission. The applicant shall also show proof that he or she has completed at least six hours of course work in Alabama real estate which is approved by the commission. Applicants for a reciprocal license shall not be subject to the complete examination or temporary license requirements of Section 34-27-33, but shall pass a reasonable written examination prepared by the commission on the subject of Alabama real estate.

exists.quote: There is created the Alabama Real Estate Commission. The commission shall consist of nine members appointed by the Governor

credential_type.quote: A license for a broker or a salesperson shall be registered to a specific real estate office and shall be issued only to, and held only by, a person who meets all of the following requirements

title_protection.quote: Present himself or herself, or be presented, as being able to perform an act for which a license is required.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license by fraud, misrepresentation, deceit, or material misstatement in an application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring or attempting to procure a license for himself or herself or another by fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit, or by making a material misstatement of fact in an application for a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in misrepresentation or dishonest or fraudulent acts when selling, buying, trading, or renting own or family real property.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in misrepresentation or dishonest or fraudulent acts when selling, buying, trading, or renting real property of his or her own or of a spouse, child, or parent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a material misrepresentation or failing to disclose known latent structural defects or other significant defects to a potential purchaser or lessee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a material misrepresentation or failing to disclose to a potential purchaser or lessee any latent structural defect or any other defect known to the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false promises likely to influence any person to enter into a contract or agreement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false promises of a character likely to influence, persuade, or induce any person to enter into any contract or agreement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making of false promises through agents or advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or the making of false promises through agents or salespersons or any medium of advertising or otherwise.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing or causing to be published any advertisement that deceives or is likely to deceive the public or creates a misleading impression.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing or causing to be published any advertisement that deceives or that is likely to deceive the public, or that in any manner tends to create a misleading impression.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge and written consent of all parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge and written consent of all parties for whom he or she acts.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to properly account for or remit money belonging to others, commingling funds, or failing to maintain required separate accounts.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within a reasonable time, to properly account for or remit money coming into his or her possession which belongs to others, or commingling money belonging to others with his or her own funds.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Placing a sign on any property offering it for sale, lease, or rent without the consent of the owner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Placing a sign on any property offering it for sale, lease, or rent without the consent of the owner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to voluntarily furnish a copy of each listing, contract, lease, and other document to each party executing the document.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to voluntarily furnish a copy of each listing, contract, lease, and other document to each party executing the document with reasonable promptness.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or dividing any commission or fee with anyone other than a licensee or multiple listing service.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying any profit, compensation, commission, or fee to, or dividing any profit, compensation, commission, or fee with, anyone other than a licensee or multiple listing service.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or receiving any rebate from any person in a real estate transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying or receiving any rebate from any person in a real estate transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing any party to a contract to breach it for personal gain by substituting a new contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inducing any party to a contract to breach the contract for the purpose of substituting a new contract where the substitution is motivated by the personal gain of the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Salesperson or associate broker accepting commission from any person other than their qualifying broker.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the licensee is a salesperson or associate broker, accepting a commission or other valuable consideration for performing any act for which a license is required from any person or company except his or her qualifying broker.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing or engaging in advertising as a real estate agent without the qualifying broker's or company's name appearing prominently.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: allowing a salesperson or associate broker licensed under him or her to advertise himself or herself as a real estate agent without the name or trade name of the qualifying broker or company appearing prominently on the advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Establishing an association with an unlicensed person expected to act as a licensee, or aiding circumvention of licensing requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Establishing an association, by employment or otherwise, with an unlicensed person who is expected or required to act as a licensee, or aiding, abetting, or conspiring with a person to circumvent the requirements of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose to an owner the licensee's intention to acquire an interest in property the licensee was employed to sell.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose to an owner the licensee's intention to acquire, directly or indirectly, an interest in property which he or she or his or her associates have been employed to sell.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or disregarding any provision of this chapter or any rule, regulation, or order of the commission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or disregarding any provision of this chapter or any rule, regulation, or order of the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting a 'net listing' agreement for sale of real property where the broker receives all proceeds above a fixed net price.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a broker accepts a "net listing" agreement for sale of real property or any interest therein.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting or failing to disclose to any lender, guaranteeing agency, or other interested party the true terms of a sale.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresenting or failing to disclose to any lender, guaranteeing agency, or any other interested party, the true terms of a sale of real estate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to inform the buyer or seller at the time an offer is presented about expected closing costs and their approximate amount.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to inform the buyer or seller at the time an offer is presented that he or she will be expected to pay certain closing costs and the approximate amount of those costs.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to, or been convicted of, a felony or a crime involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to, or having been found guilty of or convicted of, a felony or a crime involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a final money judgment rendered as a result of an act or omission in the pursuit of real estate business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a final money judgment rendered against him or her which results from an act or omission occurring in the pursuit of his or her real estate business or involves the goodwill of an existing real estate business.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering free lots or conducting lotteries to influence a party to purchase or lease real estate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering free lots or conducting lotteries for the purpose of influencing a party to purchase or lease real estate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to include a fixed date of expiration in a written listing agreement or failing to leave a copy with the principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to include a fixed date of expiration in a written listing agreement or failing to leave a copy of the agreement with the principal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct that constitutes or demonstrates dishonest dealings, bad faith, or untrustworthiness.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct that constitutes or demonstrates dishonest dealings, bad faith, or untrustworthiness.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting negligently or incompetently in performing an act for which a real estate license is required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting negligently or incompetently in performing an act for which a person is required to hold a real estate license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to produce a document, book, or record in licensee's possession concerning a real estate transaction for inspection by the commission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing on demand to produce a document, book, or record in his or her possession concerning a real estate transaction conducted by him or her for inspection by the commission or its authorized personnel or representative.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within a reasonable time to provide information requested by the commission during an investigation or after a formal complaint.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing within a reasonable time to provide information requested by the commission during an investigation or after a formal complaint has been filed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing without cause to surrender to the rightful owner, on demand, a document or instrument in the licensee's possession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing without cause to surrender to the rightful owner, on demand, a document or instrument coming into his or her possession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Qualifying broker or company failing to keep copies of all contracts, leases, listings, and other records pertinent to real estate transactions for three years.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a qualifying broker or company, failing to keep in his, her, or its files copies of all contracts, leases, listings, and other records pertinent to real estate transactions for a period of three years.

definition_quote.value: It shall be unlawful for any person...for a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration...to do any of the following unless licensed under Articles 1 and 2 of this chapter: (1) Sell, exchange, purchase, rent, or lease real estate situated within the State of Alabama. (2) Offer to sell, exchange, purchase, rent, or lease real estate situated within the State of Alabama. (3) Negotiate or attempt to negotiate the listing, sale, exchange, purchase, rental, or leasing of real estate situated within the State of Alabama.
definition_quote.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation, branch office, or lawfully constituted business organization, as the Legislature may from time to time provide, for a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration, or with the intention or expectation of receiving or collecting a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration from another, to do any of the following unless licensed under Articles 1 and 2 of this chapter

license_tiers.quote: ASSOCIATE BROKER. Any broker other than a qualifying broker... BROKER. Any person licensed as a real estate broker under Articles 1 and 2 of this chapter... SALESPERSON. broker_of_record_required.quote: An application for a company license or branch office license shall be made by a qualifying broker on a form prescribed by the commission. The qualifying broker shall be an officer, partner, or employee of the company.

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: Proof that he or she has had an active real estate salesperson license in any state for at least 24 months of the 36-month period immediately preceding the date of application.

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: Proof that he or she has completed a course in real estate approved by the commission, which shall be a minimum of 60 clock hours.

value: single agent
dual agent
transaction facilitator
agency_relationship_types.quote: When engaged in any real estate transaction, the licensee may act as a single agent, dual agent, or as a transaction facilitator.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: DUAL AGENCY. An agency relationship in which a licensee, with the informed written consent of all parties to a transaction, represents both the seller and the buyer in the same real estate transaction once all parties have signed a consent agreement.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: When two or more licensees under the same qualifying broker are in separate agency agreements with a different party in the same transaction, the qualifying broker may designate those licensees as single agents as to the licensee's client.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: TRANSACTION FACILITATOR. A licensee who assists one or more parties in a contemplated real estate transaction without being an agent or fiduciary or advocate for the interest of that party to a transaction.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: The licensee shall provide a written disclosure form to a consumer for signature describing the types of brokerage services, as identified in subsection (a), that are available to clients and customers of real estate brokerage companies, as soon as reasonably possible and before any confidential information is disclosed to any other person by a licensee.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: a written brokerage agreement is required prior to a licensee either listing for sale or submitting an offer on a property on behalf of a consumer, customer, or client for compensation.

value: Representation disclosure clause identifying the listing licensee's role (agent of seller, dual agent, or transaction facilitator)
Representation disclosure clause identifying the selling licensee's role (agent of buyer, dual agent, or transaction facilitator)
sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: Each offer to purchase shall prominently display a representation disclosure clause in the following form, completed and initialed as indicated

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Failing to include a fixed date of expiration in a written listing agreement or failing to leave a copy of the agreement with the principal.

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: If a qualifying broker or company, failing to keep in his, her, or its files copies of all contracts, leases, listings, and other records pertinent to real estate transactions for a period of three years.

escrow_account_required.quote: Failing to deposit and account for at all times all funds belonging to, or being held for others, in a separate federally insured account or accounts in a financial institution located in Alabama.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: Failing, within a reasonable time, to properly account for or remit money coming into his or her possession which belongs to others, or commingling money belonging to others with his or her own funds.

fixed_office_required.quote: An applicant for a company or broker license shall maintain a place of business.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: Each company or branch office shall be under the direction and supervision of a qualifying broker licensed at that address.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: A salesperson or associate broker shall not perform acts for which a license is required unless licensed under a qualifying broker.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: This subdivision shall not prevent an associate broker or salesperson from owning any lawfully constituted business organization, including, but not limited to, a corporation or limited liability company or limited liability corporation, for the purpose of receiving payments contemplated in this subsection.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: The commission shall establish and maintain a Recovery Fund from which an aggrieved party may recover actual or compensatory damages, not including interest and court costs, sustained only within the State of Alabama as a result of conduct of a broker or salesperson in violation of Article 1 or 2 of this chapter or the rules and regulations of the commission.

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: Payments for claims arising out of the same transaction shall not exceed twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) in the aggregate, regardless of the number of claimants.

recovery_fund_max_per_licensee.quote: Payments for claims based on judgments or settlements against any one person shall not exceed fifty thousand dollars ($50,000) in the aggregate.

time_share_cancellation_right_days.quote: You may cancel this contract without penalty or obligation within five days, not including Sunday if that is the fifth day, from the above date.

value: Owner managing or consummating a real estate transaction involving own real estate or that of spouse, child, or parent
Attorney-at-law performing duties as an attorney-at-law
Persons acting without compensation and in good faith under a duly executed power of attorney

Persons or state or federally chartered financial institutions acting as receiver, trustee, administrator, executor, or guardian, or acting under a court order or under authority of a trust instrument or will
Public officers performing their official duties
Persons performing general clerical or administrative duties for a broker so long as the person does not physically show listed property
Persons acting as the manager for an apartment building or complex (except on-site managers of condominium buildings or complexes)
Persons licensed as time-share sellers under Article 3 performing an act consistent with that article
Transactions involving the sale, lease, or transfer of cemetery lots
license_exemptions.quote: The licensing requirements of Articles 1 and 2 of this chapter shall not apply to any of the following persons and transactions
